page.notes: Catchword LOCA printed at the lower right. No page number or signature printed. Doubtful readings: "Indista[?]" (the word after "Indi" is hard to read); "62[?]" (the page number after "Proleg." reads as 6z, probably 62). Some lines were set with a large initial letter (T, V) that is joined to the following word in Tatianus, Tertullianus, Unigenitus, Voluptates, and Volkelius; the catchword and index letters are kept as lines.
